title: Season 1 wrap-up: the AI infrastructure architect role
oneliner: Season 1 in one reel: GPU clustering, inference scaling, GPU node provisioning on-premises and in cloud, caching for cost, and resilience - the AI infra architect's focus list.
says: He summarizes the AI infrastructure architect role: focus on GPU clustering, model inference scaling, provisioning GPU nodes, provisioning AI infrastructure on-premises and in the cloud of your choice (AWS, Azure, IBM), and caching - a key factor that saves organizations a lot of money.
explained: The summary doubles as a checklist for the whole season. Clustering and provisioning are the hardware literacy from Episodes 3 and 5. Inference scaling is the serving discipline of Episode 6. On-premises plus cloud is the private-hosting and edge material from Episodes 7 and 8. Caching is Episode 9's cost lever. Resilience is Episode 10.

If you watched the season out of order, this is the reel to use as the map back: each focus area names the episode that teaches it. And the closing promise - a season on the AI platform architect - is Season 2, which picks up exactly where this stops: above the infrastructure, at the shared services every team uses.
takeaway: Season 1 complete: hardware, serving, hosting, caching, resilience. The AI infra architect owns the machine room of enterprise AI.
